title: Slow charging and lift-off deceleration comments
summary: This topic combines comments about slow charging or an unreliable charging pad with separate observations about the vehicle beginning to slow when the accelerator is released.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes a slow driver-side charging pad and intermittent failure on the passenger side.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention slow charging and noticeable lift-off deceleration, but the fragments do not consistently show whether these were viewed favorably or unfavorably.

limitations: The sample is very small and most fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment picture is limited.
This cluster mixes at least two different subjects—charging behavior and lift-off deceleration—rather than one clearly coherent issue.
One undetermined fragment says charging is extremely slow, but its assigned sentiment is undetermined, so the examples do not fully clarify why it was labeled that way.
